description: Read Platonus attendance QR codes and submit check-ins.
cli: Sign in and mark attendance in the terminal
scan: Read a QR code without signing in
login_check: Verify sign-in and display the student name
port: Local port. Use 0 for a free port.
no_browser: Print the address and access key without opening a browser
clipboard: Read a QR image from the clipboard
stop_server: Press Ctrl+C to stop the server.
open_manually: Open the address in a browser and enter the local access key.
terminal_required: Use an interactive terminal that supports hidden password input.
identity: Additional ID required by the university:
paste_qr: Paste the decoded QR text, or copy a QR image and press Enter:
rejected: Platonus did not confirm attendance. Check the diagnostic log.
location_required: This QR requires coordinates. Enter your location in decimal degrees.
invalid_coordinates: Enter valid latitude and longitude in decimal degrees.
input_closed: Input closed before the operation completed.
local_error: Check the file, terminal, or requested port.
missing_dependency: Install dependencies from requirements.txt before running the app.
invalid_university_url: Enter the public HTTPS address of your university's Platonus portal.
unsupported_university: This address did not respond as a supported Platonus mobile API.
unsupported_authentication: This university uses a sign-in method that this client does not support.
invalid_credentials: The university did not accept the sign-in details.
session_expired: Your Platonus session expired. Sign in again.
upstream_unavailable: The university's Platonus server is temporarily unavailable.
api_changed: The university returned an unexpected response. See the diagnostic log.
upstream_rejected: The university rejected the request. See the diagnostic log.
submission_unknown: The outcome is unknown. Check the university journal before submitting again.
rate_limited: The server is limiting requests. Wait and try again.
invalid_qr: The text is not a supported Platonus attendance QR.
invalid_image: The file could not be read as a supported image.
image_too_large: The image exceeds the size limit.
clipboard_empty: Copy a QR image to the clipboard or use --image.
qr_not_found: No Platonus attendance QR was found.
ambiguous_qr: Crop the image to one attendance QR.
